experiments.name: Romantic Relationship Formation & Courtship
experiments.description: Two unpartnered individuals with positive attraction date and advance from interest to formal dating.
experiments.summary: Romantic relationship successfully advanced to dating with 4 dates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Repeated courtship dates increase mutual affection, trust, and commitment

experiments.name: Jealousy Emergence and Infidelity Dynamics
experiments.description: An individual in a low-commitment relationship encounters an attractive third party, leading to an affair.
experiments.summary: Secret infidelity emerged under low commitment and high conflict.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low commitment and high friction make infidelity plausible under third-party attraction

experiments.name: Infidelity Discovery, Trust Collapse & Separation
experiments.description: Discovery of secret infidelity destroys betrayed partner trust, causing relationship termination.
experiments.summary: Discovery collapsed trust to 0.25 resulting in cohabiting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Infidelity discovery causes catastrophic trust collapse and confrontation outcome

experiments.name: Unrequited Love, Heartbreak Grief & Recovery
experiments.description: An individual experiencing heartbreak processes emotional grief with measurable recovery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heartbreak recovery progresses gradually over consecutive ticks

experiments.name: Family Caregiving & Intergenerational Elder Support
experiments.description: Adult child provides care and living allowance to an elderly relative with reduced health.
experiments.summary: Elder received physical care and $15 support transfer from adult child.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elder care stabilizes elderly health and transfers support funds strictly from child savings

experiments.name: Child Dependency, Parental Care & Attachment
experiments.description: Parent performs childcare: child hunger is relieved and affection emotion is formed.
experiments.summary: Childcare successfully reduced hunger and generated affection attachment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parental childcare reduces child hunger and fosters affection emotion

experiments.name: Illness Onset, Symptom Progression & Clinical Recovery
experiments.description: Individual contracts illness, presents to clinic, receives treatment, and recovers safely.
experiments.summary: Patient contracted waterborne illness, received clinical treatment, and stabilized.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clinical treatment halts illness degradation and initiates recovery

experiments.name: Infectious Disease Airborne Transmission & Contact Patterns
experiments.description: Contagious individual interacts in co-located space with peers; transmission occurs based on susceptibility.
experiments.summary: Infected host transmitted contagion to 1 co-located contact(s).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Airborne respiratory infection transmits selectively to co-located susceptible peers

experiments.name: Medical Access Inequality, Clinic Capacity & Triage
experiments.description: Small clinic fills to maximum capacity; subsequent presenting patient is turned away.
experiments.summary: Dispensary admitted 2/2 and correctly rejected excess patient.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Health clinics strictly enforce physical capacity limits, turning away overflow

experiments.name: Traffic Accidents & Contextual Environmental Hazards
experiments.description: High rainfall and severe driver fatigue elevate traffic accident risk and cause damage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Severe fatigue combined with stormy weather triggers traffic accident risk

experiments.name: Workplace Injuries & Fatigue Hazard Multipliers
experiments.description: Exhausted agricultural laborer operating tools incurs workplace trauma.
experiments.summary: Workplace trauma occurred during hazardous agricultural task under exhaustion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Workplace injury occurs when operating hazardous tools under severe fatigue

experiments.name: Flooding, Road Blockage & Household Displacement
experiments.description: Severe river flooding blocks access routes and degrades residential habitability.
experiments.summary: Flooding disaster blocked roads and displaced 2 individuals.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Severe flooding blocks access roads and causes residential displacement

experiments.name: Environmental Water Pollution & Community Cleanup Faena
experiments.description: Untreated waste accumulation pollutes water source; community collective action restores it.
experiments.summary: Community faena restored river potability to 0.75.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Community faena mobilizes collective action to restore water potability

experiments.name: Crime, Theft & Strict Monetary Conservation
experiments.description: Theft incident transfers funds from victim to perpetrator, rigorously preserving total money.
experiments.summary: Theft of $25 transferred strictly; conserved total money $87.00.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Total currency is strictly conserved during theft without creation or deletion

experiments.name: Acute Financial Shock, Informal Day Labor & Recovery
experiments.description: Individual suffering financial drainage works as an agricultural day laborer to survive.
experiments.summary: Informal agricultural labor restored balance from $1.20 to $8.40.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Informal day labor provides immediate emergency cash liquidity

experiments.name: Multi-System Causal Cascade Traceability
experiments.description: Torrential rainfall triggers flood, road blockage, travel delay, and community restoration.
experiments.summary: Acyclic causal graph successfully traced complete chain from tropical storm to road reopening.

hypotheses.hypothesis: All cascading consequences link recursively to ancestor causes in DAG without cycles

experiments.name: Multi-Seed Robustness, Uncertainty & Null Outcomes
experiments.description: Stochastic hazard, contagion, water and romance mechanisms are re-run across five seeds to measure spread and confirm that null outcomes remain reachable.
experiments.summary: Across 5 seeds: traffic accident rate 0.0000-0.0200 (dry/rested) vs 0.1467-0.2467 (storm/fatigued); zero-infection trials 0.53-0.68; romance formations 20-20 of 20.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contextual risk ordering (storm + fatigue vs dry + rested) is stable across seeds
Not every exposure produces infection; null trials persist across seeds
Potable water produces no illness while contaminated water does
Stochastic rates differ between seeds, so uncertainty must be reported
Romantic interest can fail: wide age-gap pairings are partly filtered out
